description: This file configures UI components for react-awesome-query-builder, including widget factories, rendering functions, and settings integration for a query builder interface.

methods.name: renderComponent
methods.description: Renders a React component with given props, or a placeholder if props are undefined.

methods.name: withFactoryWidgets
methods.description: Enhances widgets with factory functions for rendering.

methods.name: withRenderFnsSettings
methods.description: Augments settings with rendering functions for various UI components.

methods.name: withRaqbSettingsAndWidgets
methods.description: Combines configuration, settings, and widgets into a final object for the query builder.
